name: gPhysicsBoardsConfineType
description: Index selecting the confinement algorithm used for board-physics boundary enforcement.

name: gPhysicsOnBoardJump
description: Enables physics simulation during board-jump animations.

name: gPhysicsOnDiveEnter
description: Enables physics simulation at the moment a player enters a dive animation.

name: gPhysicsOnDiveLoop
description: Enables continuous physics simulation during the looping phase of a dive animation.

name: gPhysicsOnFleuryUcc
description: Enables physics simulation during the Fleury (goalie) UCC animation sequence.

name: gProfileTrackerMinFramesOfChoiceToShowForecheckSuggestions
description: Minimum frames of consistent choice required before forecheck suggestions are displayed.

name: gProfileTracker_UseOriginalDest2
description: Forces the profile tracker to use the original secondary destination instead of a recalculated one.

name: gReqAngularVelocityForVisibleTurn
description: Minimum angular velocity a skater must reach for a turning animation to be triggered.

name: gSlightTurnLeanThreshold
description: Lean angle value above which a skater turn is classified as a slight turn animation.

name: gUseLeanToDetermineVisibleAnimType
description: When enabled, lean value is used instead of angular velocity to pick the visible turn animation.

name: gAllowNoVisConForMostOffensivePlayersOnDefense
description: Allows the most offensively-positioned players to skip vision control when defending.

name: gAlwaysVisionControlInDefensiveZone
description: Forces vision control to be active at all times when the player is in the defensive zone.

name: gCancelForMostOffensivePlayersIfUserRequested
description: Lets the user manually cancel vision control on the most offensive players.

name: gDisableRushVisionControl
description: Disables automatic vision control during rush situations.

name: gDoNotLockOnWindupMaxFeetToAcquisitionPos
description: If the acquisition position is farther than this, lock-on is suppressed during a windup.

name: gDoNotLockOnWindupMaxFeetToAcquisitionPosBehind
description: Same as no-lock-on windup distance but applied when the acquisition position is behind the player.

name: gDoNotLockOnWindupMaxFutureFrames
description: Number of frames ahead used in puck-arrival prediction for the no-lock-on-windup check.

name: gDoNotLockOnWindupPuckAlwaysHeadingTowardsMe
description: When enabled, assumes puck is always heading toward the player during windup lock-on evaluation.

name: gDoNotLockOnWindupWhenBeingPassedTo
description: Suppresses windup lock-on when a pass is detected heading toward the player.

name: gEnableLockOnOnWindup
description: Allows the vision system to lock on to a target while the player is in a shot windup.

name: gEnableLockOnOnWindupRush
description: Allows lock-on during shot windups specifically when the team is on a rush.

name: gGapControlVisConBuffer
description: Spatial buffer used by gap-control logic when engaging vision control on a defenseman.

name: gGapControlVisConBufferMaintain
description: Buffer distance used to maintain gap-control vision control once it has been established.

name: gGapControl_ZFromNetTurnOff
description: Z-axis distance from the net at which gap-control vision control is turned off.

name: gMaintainVisionControlWhenControllerIsIdleAutoBackskateOff
description: Keeps vision control active when the controller is idle and auto-backskate is disabled.

name: gMaintainVisionControlWhenControllerIsIdleAutoBackskateOn
description: Keeps vision control active when the controller is idle and auto-backskate is enabled.

name: gMaxEffortToUseFaceDirWhenUserVisCon
description: Effort level ceiling above which face-direction is used instead of vision-control direction.

name: gMinEffortForVisConBackskate
description: Minimum effort value required for vision-control to trigger a backskate.

name: gMinSpeedToUseMovingOffpuckOffZoneVisCon
description: Player must exceed this speed for the moving off-puck off-zone vision control to activate.

name: gMinZToPuckForForecheckVisionControl
description: Minimum Z-axis distance from the puck required to enter forecheck vision control.

name: gMinZToPuckForMaintainForecheckVisionControl
description: Minimum Z-axis distance to maintain forecheck vision control once activated.

name: gNoVisionControlForMostOffensivePlayers
description: Disables automatic vision control for the most offensively-positioned teammates.

name: gPointManGetPuckVisConRange
description: Range within which a point-man activates get-puck vision control behavior.

name: gUsersAlwaysVisionControlInOffensiveZone
description: Forces vision control to be always active for user-controlled players in the offensive zone.

name: gVCBreakoutMovingSlowlyMPH
description: Speed threshold in MPH below which a breakout player is considered to be moving slowly.

name: gVisConBreakout
description: Enables vision control behavior during breakout situations.

name: gVisConDefenseFocusReturnIfUserRequested
description: Returns defense-focus vision control to user control if the user explicitly requests it.

name: gVisConIsBackskateForCarrier
description: When enabled, vision control input triggers a backskate for the puck carrier.

name: gVisConPuckBehindFaceUpIce
description: When puck is behind the player, vision control forces facing up-ice.

name: gVisConPuckInFrontFaceUpIce
description: When puck is in front of the player, vision control forces facing up-ice.

name: gVisConStabilizePointOffHalfBuffer
description: Half-buffer distance used when stabilizing the vision-control target point in the off zone.

name: gDisableWrapArounds
description: Disables wrap-around shot attempts for all players.

name: gDisableWrapAroundsDuringFakeShot
description: Prevents a wrap-around from triggering while a fake shot animation is active.

name: gMaxWrapAroundTimeScale
description: Maximum animation time-scale multiplier applied during a wrap-around move.

name: gMinWrapAroundNormalizedRating
description: Minimum normalized player rating required to attempt a wrap-around shot.

name: gMinWrapAroundTimeScale
description: Minimum animation time-scale multiplier applied during a wrap-around move.

name: gCameraControllerID
description: Index identifying the active camera controller preset.

name: gCameraInvertY
description: Inverts the Y-axis of camera look/aim input.

name: gDisableCrowdCulling
description: Disables frustum/occlusion culling of crowd geometry; may impact performance.

name: gEnableLynxBinaryFileLoad
description: Enables loading pre-compiled Lynx shader binaries from disk instead of compiling at runtime.

name: gEnablePostFX
description: Toggles all post-processing effects (bloom, color grading, etc.) on the rendered frame.

name: gEnablePostFXDebugInfo
description: Overlays post-processing debug information on screen for shader development.

name: gEnableRenderCamera
description: Enables the render camera system used to drive scene rendering from a camera transform.

name: gLODShader
description: Selects the level-of-detail shader tier applied to materials based on object distance.

name: gOverrideCameraEuler
description: Debug index selecting which Euler-angle component to override on the render camera.

name: gOverrideCameraPos
description: Debug index selecting which position axis to override on the render camera.

name: gOverrideCameraSettings
description: Enables debug overrides for render camera position and Euler angles.
